findings.detail: The extracted fair-value sum includes the 98,605 thousand affiliated-investments subtotal in addition to its underlying positions.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows extracted fair value of 4,579,623 thousand versus the filing schedule total investments of 4,481,018 thousand. The 98,605 thousand excess exactly equals the source subtotal for total non-controlled/affiliated investments at table 42 row 20, proving that subtotal was counted alongside the underlying positions.
